verified_fixes.issue: The synchronizer incorrectly equated documentation and runtime revisions
verified_fixes.fix: Track and validate the two revisions separately, synchronize Staff too, and retain the documented earlier response profile without relaxing business-field validation

verified_fixes.issue: Retry-After was truncated to ten seconds and HTTP dates were ignored
verified_fixes.fix: Respect the complete server wait; skip automatic retries that cannot fit the request budget

verified_fixes.issue: Staff/identity/onboarding stream reads could outlive their timeout when the transport ignored its abort signal
verified_fixes.fix: Abort-aware bounded streams cancel and return a safe timeout/failure without reporting a successful write

verified_fixes.issue: Website/Customer JSON had no byte limit
verified_fixes.fix: Cancel oversized streams and return a non-retryable transport error

verified_fixes.issue: A non-JSON proxy rate-limit page became a generic schema error
verified_fixes.fix: Preserve safe HTTP status, request identifier and Retry-After while excluding raw proxy content

verified_fixes.issue: Missing Auth configuration and provider outages could escape the login form or appear as incorrect credentials
verified_fixes.fix: Return safe Swedish configuration/outage/throttling errors and preserve authentication redirects

verified_fixes.issue: Checkout JSON body was read completely before enforcing its size and malformed origins could throw
verified_fixes.fix: Bound and cancel streaming input with a read deadline and reject malformed origins safely
